summary: Backend-only test of Status Comparison Report bug fix (readiness_status = original device.status, not AI-adjusted detailed_status). All 4 targeted pytest tests PASSED against the public preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (>9700 lines). Consider modularizing feature sections (e.g., status_comparison_report) into their own routers.

_fetch_all_devices_for_subscriber uses concurrency=implicit (asyncio.gather over 8 statuses). Fine, but consider a hard cap on total devices per subscriber to guard against runaway N per-device calls in _fetch_original_readiness_for_sids (currently semaphore=20, good, but the outer report could take minutes for large fleets).

In _build_status_comparison_rows, sentinel_id is used as aed_serial fallback with a code comment saying Readisys doesn't expose a separate serial. Consider surfacing this to the frontend as null rather than duplicating sid.
Recurring backend log warning '[AEDA-Cache] warmer error: Cannot use MongoClient after close' — unrelated to this bug but worth investigating; happens after WatchFiles reloads.
seed_data_creation: None. Read-only endpoints against live Readisys upstream.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_status_comparison_report.py validates the Status Comparison Report bug fix. Key evidence: ODWCB-S15 at Lawson State Community College returns readiness_status='UNKNOWN' and assigned_status='REPOSITION' with match=false, exactly matching the report.cardiac-solutions.ai reference. Public URL was briefly slow/timing out at test start; a supervisorctl restart of backend cleared it. Report endpoint takes ~30-50s for medium fleets because it fan-outs one /voice/subscriber/{sub}/device/{sid} call per AED — set client timeouts >=120s.
